label: Effect of COVID-19 vaccination and SARS-CoV-2 infection status on mortality risk in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: a nationwide population-based cohort study.
summary: BACKGROUND: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccination is suggested to be effective in improving outcomes of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, real-world evidence on long-term mortality among individuals with COPD, accounting for both vaccination and COVID-19 infection status, remains sparse.
